Our services

Emergency door opening

  • 24-hour assistance to help you regain access to your home.
  • Non-destructive entry using specialist door-opening techniques.
  • Broken-key removal and assistance with failed door locks.
  • Support for wooden, uPVC, composite and aluminium doors.

Lock repairs & replacement

  • Repairs to restore smooth, secure operation of existing locks.
  • Replacement locks and cylinders selected to suit your door.
  • Repairs to uPVC and composite door locking mechanisms.
  • Lock changes after moving home, lost keys or a break-in.
